text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaan! Good morning! Thank you for 
giving me time off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was the first time in a while I 
could spend time in the dorm's common 
room, so—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning up, helping make dinner... I was 
able to show my appreciation to the staff!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm raring to go! I'm 
gonna give it my all in training too!

Kitasan Black made great use of her day 
off and seems nicely refreshed.
